claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The car's headlights snap on and cast two pale beams through near-total darkness.
A headlight click, low engine idle, faint wind, tires on pavement, and a low sparse score accompany the action.

subjects.description: A dark, low-slung car with reflective bodywork and paired front headlights, presented as the moving subject of the scene.
The car's paired front headlights, dark at first and then switching on to cast two pale beams.
Two pale beams of light cutting through near-total darkness and sweeping across the pavement.
A near-total dark space around the car, with only a faint ambient glow at the edges.
Smooth pavement low in the scene, catching the headlight beams as the car advances.
